hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; "$d/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true

hooks.statusMessage: Removing worktrees whose PR is finished
hooks.command: r=".claude/hooks/cleanup-merged-worktrees.sh"; s="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/$r"; [ -f "$s" ] || { g=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); s="${g%/.git}/$r"; }; [ -f "$s" ] && bash "$s" || true
